description: Dynaset P over T: MoveNext twice, read ID, Clone into C; read C's BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, ID and Bookmark, and P's Bookmark; C MoveFirst, read P's ID; C Edit, set V 'clone', Update; read LastModified of P and C; Close P; C MoveNext, read ID and RecordCount; Close C. Then dynaset Q, Clone into Q2 at once, read Q2 RecordCount, Q2 MoveLast, read Q's and Q2's RecordCount. Asks the clone's initial position, shared versus private state, and survival after the parent closes. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
